```{r setup}
project_root <- rprojroot::find_rstudio_root_file()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = file.path(project_root, "newt_a1_browser"))
setwd(file.path(project_root, "newt_a1_browser"))

pacman::p_load(AnnotationForge, data.table, tidyverse) # tidyverse last, so that select() is the dplyr one
```


#Package Tables
```{r}
# Genes, their annotation and GO terms (5_gene_clusters.Rmd, 6_cluster_annotation.Rmd). All genes go in, so that every transcript finds its gene
genes <- fread("reference/clusters/annotation_nvir_clusters.csv.gz")

gene_info <- genes %>%
  select(GID = GENEID, SYMBOL, GENENAME)

uniprot <- genes %>%
  filter(!is.na(UNIPROT)) %>%
  select(GID = GENEID, UNIPROT) %>%
  separate_rows(UNIPROT, sep = "; ")

go <- fread("reference/clusters/go_nvir_clusters.csv.gz") %>%
  select(GID = GENEID, GO, EVIDENCE)

tx <- fread("reference/clusters/tx2gene_nvir_clusters.csv.gz") %>%
  select(GID = GENEID, TXID = TXNAME)
```


#Package
```{r}
# AnnotationForge writes a package with the database into a temporary folder. GO IDs unknown to GO.db are dropped
build_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "org_build")
dir.create(build_dir)

makeOrgPackage(gene_info = gene_info,
               uniprot = uniprot,
               go = go,
               tx = tx,
               version = "1.0.0",
               maintainer = "Georgii Vdovin <gvdovin@age.mpg.de>",
               author = "Georgii Vdovin",
               outputDir = build_dir,
               tax_id = "8316",
               genus = "Notophthalmus",
               species = "viridescens",
               goTable = "go")
```


```{r}
# Only the database is taken, the package files in org.Nv.eg.db/ are written by hand. VACUUM removes the empty space AnnotationForge leaves,
# xz compresses it for GitHub, and the package unpacks it on the first load (R/zzz.R). Sizes in MB
db <- file.path(build_dir, "org.Nviridescens.eg.db/inst/extdata/org.Nviridescens.eg.sqlite")

con <- DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), db)
DBI::dbExecute(con, "VACUUM")
DBI::dbDisconnect(con)

xz <- xzfile("org.Nv.eg.db/inst/extdata/org.Nv.eg.sqlite.xz", "wb", compression = 9)
writeBin(readBin(db, "raw", file.size(db)), xz)
close(xz)

file.size(db) / 1e6
file.size("org.Nv.eg.db/inst/extdata/org.Nv.eg.sqlite.xz") / 1e6
```


```{r}
# The tx2gene for tximport and the scripts that made the package are included (the Myf5, Myog and Myf6 contigs are written by package_inputs.R)
file.copy("reference/clusters/tx2gene_nvir_clusters.csv.gz", "org.Nv.eg.db/inst/extdata", overwrite = TRUE)

scripts <- c("build/package_inputs.R",
             "build/input/blast/blast_all_vs_all.sh", "build/input/blast/blastx_hit_proteins.sh",
             "build/input/uniprot/fetch_uniprot_go.py", "build/input/uniprot/fetch_uniprot_fasta.py",
             "build/5_gene_clusters.Rmd", "build/6_cluster_annotation.Rmd", "build/7_org_package.Rmd")

file.copy(scripts, "org.Nv.eg.db/inst/scripts", overwrite = TRUE)
```


```{r eval = FALSE}
# Install from the folder, then library(org.Nv.eg.db)
install.packages("org.Nv.eg.db", type = "source", repos = NULL)
```
